module.title: Quality Assurance Lab and Test Evidence
module.business_purpose: A governed quality-assurance laboratory for the platform's integrations and critical workflows. Stores reusable test suites and cases, executable runs against named environments, per-case results, and — crucially — the exact request payloads SENT and response payloads RECEIVED for every step, so any integration failure can be reproduced, audited and diffed against the contract in module 12/31.
